notes: Dev superfan: the cheap-model watcher (cloudflare/superfan) of the dev platform Worker
(yonedarepo-dev-platform), with its own ledger and a $1/day cap. It keeps the platform's tail
events and, hourly, reads the GraphQL Analytics API. The Durable Object namespace, queue and
CheckContainer ids it queries are looked up by name at run time (no ids in this config), so
CF_ANALYTICS_TOKEN needs Account Analytics Read plus Workers Scripts Read, Queues Read and
Containers Read (all read-only). Secrets, set from stdin (~/.config/yonedarepo/staging.env):
CF_ANALYTICS_TOKEN  API token with the read permissions above
SUPERFAN_READ_TOKEN bearer for GET /findings, GET /status, POST /run
Deployed first: the dev platform names this Worker in tail_consumers.
Dev platform Worker (dev.yonedarepo.com stack): the source platform, with its own
Durable Object namespaces, Artifacts namespace, R2,
D1, queues, workflow, check containers and secrets, so it shares nothing with production
(yonedarepo-prod-*). Browsers reach it through the dev front Worker's
/api/v1 proxy (PLATFORM service binding); workers.dev stays on for direct API benches.
OWNER_TOKEN  dev-only owner credential (~/.config/yonedarepo/staging.env, name kept)
Run next to the data: a commit makes about ten round trips to its repository's
Durable Object, R2 (ENAM) and Artifacts, so each costs a hop to the client's colo
otherwise. New repository objects are created near the placed Worker.
The dev superfan (wrangler.dev-superfan.jsonc) receives this Worker's tail
events: outcomes, logs, exceptions and CPU/wall time, with no API token.
Batched landing, with commits beginning from and main reads served by the published
head. No LAND_MODE_OVERRIDE: per-request mode headers are for benches only.
PUSH_BUNDLES=on writes a large push's objects as bundles (one R2 object per batch, indexed by the repository authority). Turn it off before rolling back below the bundle reader.

PACK_CACHE=on serves a clone's pack (full, partial, shallow, or a partial clone's checkout) from a stored copy (derived/v1/<repo>/packs/), stored by the first such clone or by a pack-build job it hands off to, and built for main's tip by a job a minute after a push (repositories of 5,000+ objects; PACK_BUILD_MIN_OBJECTS); off builds every pack from the bundles.

BLOB_WRITE_THROUGH=on writes each API commit's blobs to R2 after the commit's own I/O, so burst read-backs skip the commit shards; off leaves them to the shard drain. Off since 2026-10-28: 6 interleaved dev bursts gave land p95 1.7-2.1 s off vs 2.7-3.2 s on, with read p95 0.18-0.32 s off (target < 2 s).
Check runs take minutes (container start, the check): one per invocation, up to
the container limit (4) at once, apart from the derive and projection jobs above.
api.dev.yonedarepo.com is the platform API's own hostname (Custom Domain plus the exact route); WEB_ORIGIN is where people approve device logins (/device).

Model checks call the review model with REVIEW_MODEL_KEY, the managed Z.ai key (Secrets Store secret ZAI, the same store key the front Worker's managed connections use), bound to the platform Worker itself.
Git LFS (/git/<repo>.git/info/lfs) hands out presigned R2 URLs on the OBJECTS bucket's S3 API
(LFS_S3_ENDPOINT, LFS_S3_BUCKET). Secrets: LFS_S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID / LFS_S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, the
S3 key pair of an R2 API token with Object Read & Write on that bucket only. Without them LFS answers 501.
Clone packs (platform-pack-builder.ts): one PackBuilder container per repository (cloudflare/pack-builder/Dockerfile,
its own image: yoneda-pack-builder and stock Git), started for each pack-build job and destroyed after it.
No internet or credentials: it reaches the repository's Artifacts mirror and the platform's smart HTTP only
through this Worker. basic: svelte's three packs (168,943 objects) peak at 386 MiB, 675 MiB rebuilding every delta.
Git over SSH (platform-ssh-gateway.ts): one SshGateway container (cloudflare/ssh-gateway/Dockerfile,
its own image, never the runtime's) runs yoneda-ssh-gateway, reaching the platform only through SELF.
SSH_FRONT_DOOR=tunnel. tunnel: the container also runs cloudflared (SSH_TUNNEL_TOKEN, a remotely
managed tunnel whose route sends ssh.dev.yonedarepo.com to ssh://localhost:2222, with no Access application so
`cloudflared access ssh` connects without a login); the cron below keeps it running (about $7 a
month on basic). connect: inbound TCP to this Worker (Spectrum, private beta). off: no container.
Secrets: SSH_GATEWAY_SECRET (32+ random characters), SSH_HOST_ED25519_KEY / SSH_HOST_ECDSA_KEY
(base64 of OpenSSH host key files, generated once and kept), SSH_TUNNEL_TOKEN (the tunnel's token).
Welcome email (account-email.ts): the platform-jobs consumer sends one per new account through
Resend (EMAIL_FROM, EMAIL_CONTACT). Its key is RESEND_API_KEY, the Secrets Store secret
Resend-Yoneda, read at send time; without it email is off and sign-up never depends on it.
The sending domain has open and click tracking off in Resend.
Contact support (platform-support.ts) emails SUPPORT_EMAIL through Resend from EMAIL_FROM; without it the form answers 503.
Site traffic (worker/platform-site-traffic.ts) reads the front Worker's yonedarepo_dev_site_events dataset (SITE_EVENTS_DATASET)
through the Analytics Engine SQL API: CF_ACCOUNT_ID plus the optional secret ANALYTICS_READ_TOKEN (Account Analytics Read).
Without the token, traffic reports are unavailable and nothing else changes.

Admin pages (/api/v1/admin, platform-admin.ts): ADMIN_ACCOUNTS lists the operator accounts (comma separated; empty: only OWNER_TOKEN/Access). The sign-up notice goes to ADMIN_NOTIFY_EMAIL (empty: EMAIL_CONTACT). Credit grants and balances call the managed Worker's /admin/accounts/<account>/credit over MANAGED with MANAGED_ADMIN_TOKEN (optional secret, the managed Worker's own value; unset: grants are refused). MANAGED binds the managed Worker, which binds this one as PLATFORM: a fresh environment deploys this Worker once without MANAGED first.
Dev managed agents Worker (cloudflare/managed): YonedaRepo's maintained reviewers (code, security,
slop review), run as an ordinary API client of the platform. A workspace owner enables an agent
from the browser (front Worker /api/managed -> MANAGED service binding); the owner's own session
mints each chosen repository's token (yoneda-managed-agents: read, review, check) and webhook
(change, branch) to https://managed.dev.yonedarepo.com/hooks/<repo>. That hostname serves only signed webhooks and
/health. Runs are queued (RUNS, at least once) and run as one Workflow instance per run (REVIEWS):
a HarnessContainer (cloudflare/containers/harness: Claude Code, Codex, opencode, pinned) with no
internet clones the change lazily and runs the agent's CLI; its only ways out are the Worker's
outbound handlers (platform reads with the token added, AI Gateway with the key added, metered
per request). The Worker posts anchored comments, a summary and the agent's check.
Model calls go through AI Gateway {prefix}-managed-agents (AI_GATEWAY_URL; slugs in
AI_GATEWAY_PROVIDERS: anthropic and openai built in; custom-zai and custom-mimo are custom
providers with base URLs https://api.z.ai and https://api.xiaomimimo.com). Keys: Secrets Store
secrets Claude, Codex, ZAI and MiMo. Agent models and fallbacks: shared/managed-agents.ts.
Credit: one CreditLedger per workspace, $5 promotional credit, runs pause at $0; container time
is billed at the check-minute rate. Transcripts (redacted) in R2 {prefix}-managed-transcripts.
Secrets: MANAGED_VAULT_KEY (required: 64 hex characters, generated once and kept; seals each
repository's stored agent token and webhook secret, so losing it means re-enabling agents).
Optional: AI_GATEWAY_TOKEN, the gateway's token when it is authenticated; MANAGED_ADMIN_TOKEN,
bearer for POST /admin/accounts/<workspace>/credit (unset: nobody may grant).
Card billing (Stripe): STRIPE_SECRET_KEY and STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET (optional together; unset:
"coming"). Stripe's webhook endpoint is https://managed.dev.yonedarepo.com/stripe/webhook, events
setup_intent.succeeded, payment_intent.succeeded, payment_intent.payment_failed. A saved card
unlocks PROMO_CREDIT_USD once; a balance under $5 is topped up by $20 off-session.
Deployed before the front Worker, which binds it as MANAGED.
Dev front Worker (name kept from the agent layer, removed 2026-10-27): it serves the browser
app on dev.yonedarepo.com, account sign-in (/api/auth/*) and the owner session, and proxies
/api/v1 to the dev platform through the PLATFORM service binding on the same origin. Accounts
live in the platform's WorkspaceAuthority (WORKSPACES script binding). It has no stores,
containers or queues of its own; a new account's welcome email is asked of the platform over PLATFORM.
OWNER_TOKEN  dev-only owner credential (~/.config/yonedarepo/staging.env, name kept)
The exact route keeps dev.yonedarepo.com on this Worker (a route takes precedence over a
Custom Domain on one hostname, and the most specific route pattern wins).
v4 deletes the agent layer's Durable Object classes (RepositoryAuthority, LiveRoom,
AgentSandbox) and their data; the agent-run code is on the agent-run-workspaces branch.
Sign-in with GitHub and Google (worker/oauth.ts): optional secrets GITHUB_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID /
GITHUB_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET (a GitHub OAuth App) and GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID / GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET
(a Google OAuth web client). A provider whose two secrets are unset is off: hidden on the sign-in
page, its /auth/<provider>/* routes answer 404. Callback URLs: https://dev.yonedarepo.com/auth/github/callback
and https://dev.yonedarepo.com/auth/google/callback. Deploy uploads them when the secrets file has them.
/api/managed is proxied to the managed agents Worker (MANAGED service binding, deployed first).

/install.sh, /install.ps1 and /downloads/* (worker/downloads.ts): the CLI installers and releases and the public Claude Code marketplace, from the DOWNLOADS bucket that cargo xtask downloads stages and uploads.
Site analytics (worker/site-events.ts): one cookieless SITE_EVENTS data point per public HTML page view and per sign-up,
into the Analytics Engine dataset yonedarepo_dev_site_events (created on first write; infra plan/prune do not track it;
underscores, not hyphens: the dataset is a table name in Analytics Engine SQL).
No IP, cookie or visitor id; signed-in requests (session cookie), /api, /auth and assets are skipped.
WEB_ANALYTICS_TOKEN: the Cloudflare Web Analytics site token; set, the front Worker adds the beacon to public pages; empty, none.
ADMIN_ACCOUNTS: the platform Worker's operator list, repeated here for the session answer's is_admin (the admin entry in the sidebar); keep the two equal.
Dev bench client (tools/fanout-bench/worker.js): many concurrent writers for the kit's
bursts (items 8-10) and the webhook receiver boxes (POST /hooks/<box>) for the B3 gate
(tools/staging/webhook-flow.mjs). No bindings to platform state. BENCH_KEY is set once from
stdin (wrangler secret put BENCH_KEY) and kept across deploys; the kit reads it from
~/.config/yonedarepo/staging-bench.env.
The platform never calls this account's workers.dev, so the receiver has a Custom Domain,
hook-receiver.yonedaai.org (owner approved 2026-10-27), on a zone without a wildcard Worker
route (yonedarepo.com has the prod sites Worker's).
The dev stack's previous names (yonedarepo-staging-*: Workers, container apps, queues, D1,
R2, workflow, Artifacts namespace yonedarepo-staging), renamed 2026-10-27 without its data.
No current name starts with yonedarepo-staging, so a prefix is safe here.
Also the hand-written platform-dev stack (wrangler.platform/agents/superfan/eval.jsonc, deleted
2026-10-27), by exact name: its Workers and what only they bound. The Basin pipeline stream
of platform-dev (CHANGELOG) is not a kind prune knows; delete it by hand.
Also the isolated acceptance stack (yonedarepo-acceptance*, 2026-10-10 fixture) and the
standalone bench client yonedarepo-bench-client (now yonedarepo-dev-bench), by exact name.
Also the agent layer and website previews, removed 2026-10-27, by exact name: the sites
Worker, the AgentSandbox container app, the agent queues and the agent Worker's D1 and R2. The
AI Gateway yonedarepo-dev (SANDBOX_AI_GATEWAY) is not a kind prune knows; delete it by hand.
